newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK TELECOM OTE GDS QUOTED ON SEAQ INTL.
newsitem.headline: GREEK TELECOM OTE GDS QUOTED ON SEAQ INTL.

text.p: Quotation of Global Depository Shares (GDS) of OTE telecom started June 18 in London's SEAQ International market.
Subscribers to Greek Money and/or Securities will be able to view the OTE SEAQ data only in delayed format.
But subscribers with SST and satellite-only delivery will not be able to view this data.
Subscribers who need to view the data in realtime format must subscribe to European securities and take the SEAQ level 1 exchange, Reuters Hellas-Marketing said.
Subscribers with no access to SEAQ International may follow the market keying in /OTEq.L.
Prices are quoted in USD. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
